Description: Injuries caused by crashes, falls, unsafe premises, or another party's negligence.
Relevant Questions: When and where did the injury happen?
Did you receive medical care or create an incident report?
Has an insurance company, property owner, or driver contacted you?

Description: Potential harm connected to medical treatment, diagnosis, surgery, medication, or hospital care.
Relevant Questions: What treatment or diagnosis caused concern?
When did you first discover the harm?
Do you have records, bills, test results, or discharge notes?

Description: Traffic stops, arrests, license issues, or court dates connected to alleged impaired driving.
Relevant Questions: When is your next court date or license deadline?
Were breath, blood, or field sobriety tests used?
Is this your first DUI-related charge?

Description: Charges, investigations, warrants, arrests, or police contact requiring defense review.
Relevant Questions: What charge or investigation are you facing?
Were you arrested, cited, or served paperwork?
Do you have a court date, warrant, or bond condition?

Description: Custody, support, parenting plans, domestic agreements, and related family disputes.
Relevant Questions: Are there children, custody orders, or support obligations involved?
Has anything already been filed in court?
What outcome are you trying to protect first?

Description: Marriage dissolution, property division, alimony, custody, and separation issues.
Relevant Questions: Has either spouse filed for divorce?
Are custody, support, property, or business assets disputed?
Do you have a preferred timeline for separation or filing?

Description: Visa, green card, citizenship, asylum, removal, or family petition matters.
Relevant Questions: What is your current immigration status?
Is there a filing deadline, interview, hearing, or removal date?
Are you seeking family, employment, humanitarian, or student-related help?

Description: Wrongful termination, discrimination, wage issues, harassment, retaliation, or workplace contracts.
Relevant Questions: What happened at work, and when did it happen?
Do you have messages, HR notes, pay records, or a written contract?
Have you reported the issue internally or to an agency?

Description: Contracts, entity formation, partnership disputes, vendor conflicts, or business risk review.
Relevant Questions: What agreement, entity, or business relationship is involved?
Is there a signed contract or written communication?
Are you trying to prevent a dispute or respond to one?

Description: Wills, trusts, probate, estate administration, guardianship planning, and asset transfer questions.
Relevant Questions: Do you already have a will, trust, or probate case?
Which assets, beneficiaries, or family members are involved?
Is there a recent death, incapacity, or urgent filing deadline?

Description: Closings, property disputes, lease issues, landlord tenant conflicts, and title concerns.
Relevant Questions: Is this about a purchase, sale, lease, eviction, or property dispute?
Do you have a contract, notice, lease, or title document?
What deadline or closing date is approaching?
